card.name: Dose-titration wording in opioid labels
card.fires_on: Small words and number starts right after a dose in titration sentences, such as 'a dose that provides adequate analgesia' or 'titrate ... to'. Also the first digit or letter of a dose or drug name in dosing text.

modes.label: Linking word after dose
modes.description: 'that' or 'to' following 'dose' in instructions to titrate to adequate pain relief.

modes.description: First digit of a strength or first letter of a drug name in dosing tables and interaction text.
